text: As a lonely girl, Ellen prayed for a companion and [reached the powerful being called Nosferatu|origin|deliberately called up]. In 1838 her husband Thomas Hutter [travels to Transylvania|trigger|travelling somewhere remote] to sell a decrepit manor to the reclusive Count Orlok, who takes the locket with Ellen's hair. Orlok sails for Wisburg in his coffin among plague rats, and [the town sickens and dies|threat|sickness and poison] while Ellen, seizing and sleepwalking, learns that only [a maiden's willing sacrifice|ending|dying to save others] can end him.
